title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Use conditional visibility in the updated Word add-in (Hide If Empty/False in Word Layout)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces conditional visibility controls in the Word add-in, allowing developers to design reports with hidden or shown content based on boolean fields using HideIf logic - a capability previously only available in RDLC layouts.
key_points: The Word add-in now supports HideIf logic control for conditional visibility, bringing feature parity with RDLC layouts
Developers can apply Hide If Empty and Hide If False controls to fields, tables, rows, and columns based on boolean fields in the dataset
Conditional visibility can be applied to stand-alone fields, table rows, table columns, and entire tables
Boolean fields from the report dataset and Report Extensions can be used to control when content appears

quotes.text: Awesome! That gives us one more reason to skip RDLC.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the significance: developers now have less reason to use the more complex RDLC layout type for conditional visibility scenarios.
